Name: Eliab, Son of Nahath
Summary: Son of Nahath and father of Jeroham in the Samuel line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:27: Son of Nahath and father of Jeroham in the Samuel line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Eliab stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
